title: Concept: Legacy digest via Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload) (crystal) — review required
description: In crystal, Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload) computes MD5 or SHA-1, whose collision resistance is broken for signature and identity checks. Checksums against accidental corruption remain acceptable; security uses need Digest::SHA256.hexdigest.
applicability: crystal codebases hashing with Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload); single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW severity.
